images.caption: Alternate cover — black-and-white copperplate engraving
images.style_prompt: Black-and-white copperplate engraving in the manner of an 18th-century scientific engraving, purely pictorial: a bearded classical philosopher and a serene humanoid machine seated across a table, both hands guiding a single quill writing on a long scroll, a chessboard with a crowned king between them and a marble bust of Socrates watching from a pedestal.

images.caption: Alternate cover — surrealist oil
images.style_prompt: Surrealist oil painting in the manner of Magritte, purely pictorial with no text: a marble head opening like a drawer full of gears and quills, a flesh hand and a chrome hand writing together on a scroll unrolling into a mirror corridor — distributed epistemic agency.
